findings.evidence: 'Invent facts, numbers, customers or drama to make a hook punchier' repeats step 1's factual-grounding constraint. The separate Voice and tone section also revisits the sensitive-post guidance already established in the workflow. These familiar, repeated guardrails dilute the stronger objective-selection, compression and weighted-character guidance.
findings.fix: Consolidate the anti-invention warning and its reputational rationale into step 1, and merge the sensitivity paragraph into step 3. Retain the concrete qualifier, causality, Unicode and engagement-objective rules.

findings.evidence: Step 1 requires 'every variant keeps every one of them with its qualifiers', but the overlength fallback says 'if you cannot ask, return three within-limit posts keeping the strongest point, say what was cut and offer a thread'. For essential facts that cannot all fit, this branch cannot satisfy both instructions: disclosure of cuts does not preserve every fact.
findings.fix: Make the no-questions overlength fallback return three alternative threads, preserving all supplied facts and qualifiers across each thread's posts and counting numbering prefixes. Update the output template to allow each VERSION to contain a thread; permit strongest-point standalone summaries only when the user explicitly authorizes omissions.
